purpose: Fix all search-quality issues surfaced by the headless pi verification and the sort work: page-scoped sort, silently-ignored in_stock, cold-start false 'No products found', and broken result pagination.

sort_page_scoped.detail: Alza /search.htm ignores the o= sort param (o=0/2/3 identical; sort control is client-side JS #sort_N). First fix (5ec2527/ddb9e58): client-side sort of ONE page (~24 items).

in_stock_ignored.detail: in_stock was passed to the domain but never filtered — search cards carry no stock attribute. Stock signal = card purchase CTA (verified 2026-09-12: 'Do košíku'/'Vybrat variantu' = purchasable now; standalone 'Hlídat' button = not; the 'Hlídat dostupnost nebo cenu' watch link appears on every card and must not count; CTA text uses non-breaking spaces).

cold_start_false_empty.detail: First navigation after browser launch can finish 'load' with the grid unrendered; the 15 s selector wait expired with 0 cards → 'No products found' for a query with results (observed on the first call of a probe session; same call succeeded on retry). Fix: bounded extract-retry (3 attempts).

pagination_broken.detail: search.htm?exps=…&pg=N IGNORES pg — pg=2/3 repeat page 1 exactly (20/20 code overlap, with or without o=; 3 pages → 20 unique). Alza's rendered page-number anchors point at category-style pages (e.g. /notebooky/18842920-p2.htm); those DO serve different products (page 1 ∩ cat-p2 = 0 overlap). Fix: follow the rendered pagination links (PAGE_URLS_EXTRACTOR); an explicit page beyond the rendered set now returns no results instead of silently repeating page 1.
pagination_broken.off_by_one: loop used maxPages as an index bound (n <= maxPages) so explicit page=2 visited zero pages (pages:0); fixed to n < page + maxPages.

src/domain/catalog.ts: sweep: for price/rating sorts gather candidates from up to sortSweepPages(limit) real pages (limit 50 → 3 pages → 68 candidates for 'notebook'), dedup by code, client-side sort (compareForSort)
in_stock: RawCard.inStock from CTA text (nbsp-normalized); normalizeCard → availability 'in stock'/'not purchasable now'; passesInStock filter (undetermined stock excluded when the flag is set)
fetchSearchPage: bounded render-retry + per-attempt debug log; returns {cards, pageUrls}
PAGE_URLS_EXTRACTOR: resolves rendered page-number anchors (-pN.htm pattern → page 1..N URLs)
candidatesScanned always set (how many candidates were scanned before filtering/sorting)
changes.src/tools/search-products.ts: honest descriptions (sort sweep + newest best-effort; in_stock CTA-derived; page follows rendered pagination); candidatesScanned in structuredContent
changes.src/tools/format.ts: header 'Top N result(s) … (scanned X candidates)' — no more 'Found N (showing N)'
